subject: GI ideas: W2.b micro-drill and template diversity
body:
Three ideas from GI:

1. W2.b micro-drill generator: 5-question quick drill focused on intercepts only, using sqrt, abs, quadratic vertex, exponential. Random coefficients to avoid duplicate answers.

2. Template diversity targets: cross-exam verify warns on repeated rational and fractional-exp templates. Consider rotating those templates or swapping in a different type once per exam.

3. Solution steps emphasis: for all W2.b questions, always include the f(x)=0 → isolate → solve → intercept statement. Kai's only gap is that workflow.

Happy to help draft templates.
